membership.trustTitle: Used by WebToMind's first active creators
membership.trustSubtitle: From concept art and campaign thumbnails to product visuals, creators use WebToMind to move from prompt ideas to reusable workflows.
membership.testimonialSubtitle: Fictional creator profiles that reflect the workflows WebToMind is built for.
membership.testimonialOneQuote: I use WebToMind as my visual brief room. Prompt cases, reference images, and generation history stay together, so client iterations are much easier to control.
membership.testimonialTwoQuote: For thumbnails and concept boards, the subscription pays for itself quickly. I can test more ideas without worrying about failed generations wasting credits.
membership.testimonialThreeQuote: The member prompt cases are the most useful part for me. I can learn how a result was built, then rewrite it for my own characters and campaigns.
membership.faqCreditsAnswer: Credits cover image and video generation, editing, and prompt extraction. Video pricing follows model, duration, and resolution: Mini 5s 480p costs 400 credits and Fast 5s 720p costs 1,385 credits. Reference images and first/last frames are free; reference videos add cost by input duration. Failed tasks are refunded automatically.
membership.faqSubscriptionPaygQuestion: What is the difference between subscriptions and one-time recharge?
membership.faqSubscriptionPaygAnswer: Subscriptions are best for ongoing creators who want monthly credits, member prompt cases, private generations, and better workflow value. One-time recharge is better for project spikes or temporary credit top-ups.
membership.faqFailedChargeAnswer: No. If a generation fails due to a system or model error, credits are not charged or are refunded automatically.
membership.faqCancelAnswer: Yes. You can manage cancellation through the billing portal. Your member benefits remain active until the end of the paid period.
membership.faqPromptCasesQuestion: What do member-only prompt cases unlock?
membership.faqPromptCasesAnswer: Members can view full prompts for selected cases, then recreate, rewrite, and adapt those structures inside the visual prompt workflow.
membership.faqPrivateAnswer: Subscriber generations are private by default unless you choose to publish or share them. Free and one-time credit usage may have more limited privacy controls.

membership.planCreditDescriptionPro: 10,000 credits monthly ≈ 166 base images, or about 3 Seedance 2.5 5s 720p videos.
membership.planCreditDescriptionMax: 60,000 credits monthly ≈ 1,000 base images, or about 21 Seedance 2.5 5s 720p videos.
membership.creditUsageDesc: Images are priced by size and enhancements; videos by model, duration, and resolution, with reference videos billed by input duration. These are base examples without references, and actual usage is recorded with every result.
membership.creditUsageExampleBaseDetail: Starts from standard size, best for quick layouts, social covers, and idea tests.
membership.creditUsageExample2kDetail: Best for product visuals, article covers, Prompt case recreation, and ad-ready assets.
membership.creditUsageExample4kDetail: 4K starts at {{fourKCredits}} credits. High quality starts at {{highQualityFloor}} credits without stacking the size floor twice.
membership.creditUsageExampleReferenceDetail: Reference images are billed by pixel size (about +20 credits for a 1K reference; smaller images cost less, 2K/4K cap around +30). Character consistency is billed by its reference images, with no separate mode fee.
membership.creditUsageExampleVideoMiniDetail: 400 credits for batch clips, storyboard tests, and frequent social content.
membership.creditUsageExampleVideoFastDetail: 1,385 credits for a balance of speed and HD delivery.
membership.creditUsageExampleVideoStandardLongDetai: 5,160 credits for complex motion, frame control, and flagship exploration.
membership.creditUsageExampleVideoSeedance25Detail: Current flagship model with 30s continuous output, multi-modal references and native audio; charged by exact duration and resolution. Reference images and frames are free; reference videos are billed by input duration.
membership.planComparisonDesc: Plan benefits stay the same across billing cycles; switching monthly or yearly only changes price, average monthly cost, and annual savings.
membership.planComparisonMonthlyDesc: Monthly and annual include the same benefits. Monthly is best for validating the workflow first: compare current price and credit quota.
membership.planComparisonYearlyDesc: Monthly and annual include the same benefits. Annual is best for steady creation: compare average monthly price and yearly savings.
